Chapter 1: Riddermound

Two days from Outskirt, at the eastern edge of the Iron Forest, a hill crowned with standing stones hides the barrow of a dragon knight of Eledain. Goblin grave robbers sent by Maladûk have already broken in and been slaughtered, and their noise has woken the barrow wight, which now stalks the earthen tunnels, passing through portcullises and doors in search of thieves. The heroes must slip past vampiric bats, befriend the terrified goblin Grub, get by the ghostly Lady guarding her husband's tomb, and claim the treasure from the shattered sarcophagus without springing its blade trap. They win by escaping with the prize, knowing the wight rises again if destroyed within the mound.
